# D5 · Essential services concentration

**Scope.** Electricity, grid and generation (including data-centre power deals), telecom and broadband, health insurance and pharmacy benefit management: consolidation and its effect on prices and access.

## Standing questions

- Which utility mergers or long-term power deals for data centres were reviewed, and what conditions were imposed?
- Who bears the grid and generation costs created by data-centre demand?
- Where do health insurers, PBMs or telecom carriers hold concentrated regional positions under regulatory review?

## Watched entities

Berkshire Hathaway, NextEra Energy, Dominion Energy, Constellation Energy, Vistra, Duke Energy, Southern Company, AT&T, Verizon, Comcast, Charter Communications, T-Mobile US, UnitedHealth Group, CVS Health, Cigna Group, Elevance Health
